title: Russia and China retrieval teams and the gentleman's agreement

tellings.quote: Russia and China have their own retrieval teams of non-human intelligence and they have their own technologies reverse engineered and they're pretty much on par with what we're doing.

plain: Russia and China each have their own teams for recovering craft of NHI, short for non-human intelligence, and have reverse engineered the technology, meaning taken it apart to learn how to build it, to a level "pretty much on par" with the US, according to Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle. Herrera passes this on as what he was told, linked to talk on Capitol Hill, and the story suggests a quiet understanding among the three powers about these recoveries.
